name: 347. Anthropic Message Batches: inline OpenAI-shape chat lines, file input refused, named key (anthropic-batches)
description: Wire-level pins for Anthropic Message Batches on the batch contract (TXE-6597; contract clauses C3, C4, C8). Rows: (1) input_file_id is a 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming input_file_id: Anthropic batches take inline requests only, and a vendor call would have answered differently. (2) a line whose url is not a chat operation, and (3) a line naming a model other than the batch's, are refused naming the line; nothing is sent upstream. (4) [PREVIEW] an inline OpenAI-shape chat line reaches Anthropic through the sync chat converter: the echoed request carries the system prompt as Messages' top-level system, no system-role message, and max_tokens; Anthropic would refuse the unconverted body. The batch is cancelled at once. (5) batch retrieve, cancel and results call upstream with the key the caller names and with no other key: a run-scoped provider on the Anthropic base has a dead key and a live key, and a batch id that does not exist is answered 401 by the dead key and 404 by the live one, so the status says which key was called. (6) Claude on Vertex shares the converter: a line whose url names a chat completion is converted even without OpenAI-only markers in its body, so a chat line with no messages is a 400 naming the line before anything is uploaded; before, it was passed through unconverted. (7) the unified results route returns OpenAI-shape lines, paged: against the provider error fixture's settled batch (msgbatch_fixture_settled, served at /pp/anthropic), page 1 with limit=2 holds the succeeded Message as a chat.completion with the unified usage (cache read and write details) and the raw Message, and the errored line as failed with the vendor's inner error; next_cursor leads to page 2 with the expired line and no more pages. The row runs only with providerErrorFixture=1. (8) [PREVIEW] the same route on a real settled batch, read from anthropicSettledBatchId (see folder 155): one line per page with a contract status, a succeeded line as a chat.completion with usage and the raw Message, and next_cursor leading to the next line. The Go tests in core/providers/anthropic/anthropic_test.go pin the same conversion against a stand-in vendor. Run with FEATURE="anthropic-batches".
